Native CPU one-pass CTC transcription fixture. Authored PCM16 waveform preprocessing feeds a real ONNX per-sample acoustic head. Negative samples select b, positive samples select a, near-zero blank or delimiter classes. Explicit valid lengths exclude nonblank -0.5 padding; blank-separated repetitions survive CTC collapse. Class table, 12-sample window and 4 classes are fixture data. No autoregressive prompt/tokens are required. This proves actual HTTP/runtime dataflow and frame decoding, not speech-recognition quality.
